description.zh: 传统品牌广告与宣传片，从创意、剪辑到调色，以完整后期流程构建清晰有力的叙事。
description.en: Commercials and brand films shaped through a complete creative, editing and color workflow.

description.en: Generative imagery, CGI compositing and visual experiments developed into complete video work.

description.en: Openers, broadcast packages and live content designed for pace, clarity and event identity.

description.zh: 从角色造型、视觉设定到动态呈现，建立可用于内容传播与品牌表达的角色形象。
description.en: Character styling, visual development and motion crafted into expressive, reusable identities.
